title: Localize the daily reminder's body and fix its pluralization
description: Replace the manually-pluralized template with applicationContext.resources.getQuantityString() using the new quests_waiting_body plural resource.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded string template is replaced by applicationContext.resources.getQuantityString(R.plurals.quests_waiting_body, activeTasks, activeTasks)
start_anchor: "You have $activeTasks quest${if (activeTasks > 1) "s" else ""} waiting. Don't let the loot slip away!",
